name: Habits
description: A private habit, training & reflection tracker for Standard Notes: check-off or count habits, with an optional per-habit workout log (distance, time, RPE) that rolls up in a Training view (dated weekly hours & distance, weekly goals). Today / Calendar / Training / Stats / Insights / Journal views: a day-by-day calendar log you can edit from any date, a daily progress ring, streaks, a journal with paragraphs, light formatting and backdating, mood trends, gamification (XP, levels, badges), a local Insights dashboard, and a note-size health guardrail. All data is stored inside the note and protected by Standard Notes' end-to-end encryption.
